notes: Stories created for Specialty Match Transparency feature with full layer coverage (schema, logic, API, tests, integration).

stories.title: Define Specialty Match Transparency Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define response schema exposing matched_classifications, including classification labels, confidence (if available), and pipeline origin flags (regex, vector, or both). Ensure compatibility with existing specialty_service outputs.

stories.title: Implement Dual-Pipeline Attribution Logic
stories.description: Extend specialty_service to explicitly tag each matched classification with its originating pipeline (regex, vector, or both), preserving existing deduplication and aggregation behavior.

stories.title: Expose Specialty Transparency via Facade/API
stories.description: Update find_care_facade and/or evaluate_care_facade to include specialty transparency fields in responses so frontend and chat agent can display how specialties were matched.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Transparency
stories.description: Create tests validating that classifications include correct pipeline attribution, handle dual matches, and maintain stability with query expansion and dedup logic.

per_feature.mitigation: Reuse existing matched_classifications structure and only add non-breaking metadata fields
